snippet.title: Lazy River Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Fight your way through a zombie-infested space waterpark in this cooperative first-person shooter. Build a raft, survive the chaos, and escape down the galaxy's most dangerous lazy river.

Learn more about the showcase here: theindiepremier.com
